name: Snehasparsham
benefit: - Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹1000/- per month will be given to unwed mothers.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
   1. The applicant should be an unwed mother.
   1. The applicant should be under 65 years.
   1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other pension schemes of the government. 

**Note:** The applicant must be an account holder in a post office.
